accreditationPage.title: Accreditation Programs
accreditationPage.subtitle: Comprehensive accreditation pathways for Certification Bodies, Auditors, and Training Providers ensuring global standards compliance.
accreditationPage.cbDesc: Accredit your organization as a recognized certification body capable of issuing globally accepted certifications across ISO, Cybersecurity, and Privacy domains.
accreditationPage.auditorDesc: Individual accreditation for auditors demonstrating competency in conducting assessments against international standards and frameworks.
accreditationPage.trainingDesc: Accreditation for training organizations delivering courses aligned with IUCB-recognized standards and examination frameworks.
accreditationPage.step1Desc: Submit your application with required documentation and evidence of compliance.
accreditationPage.step2Desc: Our assessment team reviews all submitted materials against accreditation criteria.
accreditationPage.step3Desc: Comprehensive on-site evaluation by qualified IUCB assessors.
accreditationPage.step4Desc: Accreditation committee reviews findings and issues the accreditation decision.
